ModuleName: Analyzing User Testing Results and Iterative Redesign
CourseName: CEN3722 - Introduction to Human Computer Interfaces

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured topic outline covering the full workflow of usability testing analysis—from distinguishing quantitative and qualitative data, collecting and organizing findings via affinity diagrams and issue logs, classifying and root-causing errors, and prioritizing fixes using severity and impact frameworks—which instructors use to sequence lessons and learners use to navigate the module's core concepts.
